description: This file defines the 'Styles' class used for reading and parsing style information from an XLSX file in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for processing font, fill, border, alignment, and protection styles, and manages style XML data and theme integration.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing style information from the XML of an XLSX file and converting it into PhpSpreadsheet style objects.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Sets the XML namespace used in style XML parsing.

methods.name: setWorkbookPalette
methods.description: Sets the color palette of the workbook.

methods.name: castBool
methods.description: Converts a value to boolean, used internally for style attribute processing.

methods.name: getStyleAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves style attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, considering the namespace.

methods.name: setStyleXml
methods.description: Sets the SimpleXMLElement containing style XML data.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Assigns a Theme object for color referencing.

methods.name: setStyleBaseData
methods.description: Initializes style, font, and cell style data for the parser.

methods.name: readFontStyle
methods.description: Parses font style XML node into a Font object.

methods.name: readNumberFormat
methods.description: Parses number format style XML into a NumberFormat object.

methods.name: readFillStyle
methods.description: Parses fill style XML into a Fill object.

methods.name: readBorderStyle
methods.description: Parses border style XML into a Borders object.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves specific attributes from style XML nodes.

methods.name: readBorder
methods.description: Parses border element details into a Border object.

methods.name: readAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Parses alignment XML settings into an Alignment object.

methods.name: formatGeneral
methods.description: Converts 'GENERAL' format string to internal representation.

methods.name: readStyle
methods.description: Reads a complete style XML node into a Style object.

methods.name: readProtectionLocked
methods.description: Parses protection 'locked' attribute into Style protection.

methods.name: readProtectionHidden
methods.description: Parses protection 'hidden' attribute into Style protection.

methods.name: readColor
methods.description: Interprets color XML node into ARGB string based on theme, indexed, or rgb attribute.

methods.name: dxfs
methods.description: Reads differential styles (dxfs) and cell styles from style XML.

methods.name: styles
methods.description: Returns the loaded styles array.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Utility to safely retrieve array items for style processing.
